name: send_webhook
description: Send a named webhook or a direct webhook URL to trigger an external automation. Use for 'trigger the slack webhook', 'send the home assistant webhook', or 'list my webhooks'. Rate limited to prevent duplicates. Use webhook='list' to see named webhooks. Not for sending email; use send_email.

webhook.description: Named webhook from registry (e.g., 'notify_slack', 'home_assistant'). Use 'list' to see available webhooks.

url.description: Final direct webhook URL (alternative to named webhook). All HTTP 3xx responses are refused for security.

data.description: JSON data to send in the webhook body

headers.description: Optional literal HTTP headers to include in the request. Environment placeholders such as ${API_KEY} are rejected; use a named registry webhook for credential headers.
